name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Anders goes with neither Titan nor Geode.
Algae goes with at least one of Fontaine or Titan.
Venus goes with at least one of Anders or Algae.
Anders, Titan, and Regolith belong to different colonists.
Rios, Callisto, and Fungus belong to different colonists.
Luna goes with exactly one of Anders, Algae, or Fungus.
Fungus goes with neither Okafor nor Earth.
Callisto goes with none of Fontaine, Fungus, or Geode.
